name: rand_mcnally_railroad_map_us_1920
projection: Rand McNally 1920 (conic-type, not equirectangular). No lon/lat formula: use the hand-picked control points (accurate to ~10-15 px at this 3840 px width; scale by width if you load a larger copy).

route_palo_alto_to_boston_px.note: Guide polyline for the SC053 yellow marker line (Overland Route via Sacramento-Reno-Ogden-Omaha-Chicago, then east). The Ogden (912,1488) and Omaha (1920,1488) points are rough estimates — smooth it with a Catmull-Rom curve.
